description: Defines a Flutter widget for selecting a product size, including a 'SelectedSize' component and a 'SizeButton' widget for rendering individual size options.

classes.name: SelectedSize
classes.description: A stateless widget providing UI for selecting a size from a list, highlighting the selected size.

classes.name: SizeButton
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a circular button for a size option, indicating active state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for both 'SelectedSize' and 'SizeButton'.
